Deloitte’s AI & Engineering team helps clients modernize technology platforms, accelerate innovation, and drive meaningful business outcomes. The Backend Developer will design and deliver scalable data architectures, pipelines, analytics products, and applications using Palantir Foundry and cloud-based technologies while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support enterprise transformation.

Building and deploying data engineering solutions that support enterprise transformation and mission-driven outcomes
Developing analytics products and applications that integrate, transform, and operationalize enterprise data
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver scalable solutions
Applying DevOps and statistical programming tools to improve data quality, platform performance, and operational efficiency

1+ years of experience with data modeling, schema management, data lineage, metadata management, and data-quality controls
1+ years of experience with CI/CD concepts and automated software delivery

Active Secret security clearance

Maven Smart System or Palantir Foundry tools, including Pipeline Builder, Code Workbooks, transforms, the Ontology, Actions, Functions, APIs, and application integrations
The War Data Platform (WDP), formerly known as Advana
REST APIs, JSON, message queues, microservices, or event-driven architectures
Observability practices, including centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and service health checks
Relational and non-relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization
Department of War, military readiness, or federal government data environments
Benefits
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
Opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship.
